features.feature_selection: none; all preregistered finite features are used
features.model: deterministic balanced L2 logistic regression, one binary model per candidate action
features.normalization: fit mean/std on each expanding training fold only
features.source: BTCUSDT open_interest_binance five-minute sum_open_interest paths ending strictly before each frozen PPOSM decision timestamp

label_contract.labels: pre-2024 frozen PPOSM counterfactual utility only; SWITCH iff candidate utility exceeds TP4 utility

purpose: test whether materially new pre-2024 OI paths can explain frozen PPOSM residual action labels before any OOS reopen

source_contract.oi_query:
SELECT ts AS date, sum_open_interest
    FROM open_interest_binance
    WHERE symbol = :symbol AND period = '5m' AND ts >= :start AND ts < :end
    ORDER BY ts

terminal_semantics: fail closed unless every acceptance check passes; no OOS repair or model promotion from a failed source-support result

validation.advance_if_all_pass: only then open a separate preregistered historical OOS/residual-router check
validation.consistent_year_direction: every evaluated candidate-year AUC must be >= 0.50
validation.split_policy: pre-2024 expanding-forward years only; validate 2021, 2022, 2023 when both classes are present and at least 80 earlier signals exist
